title: FR: Set actions to alert notifications to snooze
body:
Feature Request:
It would be great to have action(s) with the alert notifications to be able to directly snooze alerts. Not only because it's easier and faster on the phone but especially on connected watches. I'm doing most of my work on my watch but whenever an alert comes in, I can't snooze it from the watch because it doesn't have the actions. It would be great to do it from there and not need to always get the phone and open it from there.

I can try to make it work in a seperate branch but thought I'd ask about your opinions on the issue.

comments.body: Please can you add the type of watch you are using?
I'm using an Oppo Watch but the problem occurs at least on every Wear OS watch
Please provide screenshots before and after your PR.
